title: Fresh workflow-lite screen on the current engine
hypothesis: The existing workflow-lite prompt lets Astra solve coding tasks faster while preserving verification, safety, planner and tool contracts.
falsified_if: The prompt transform fails activation or the screen loses correctness; weak or mixed latency evidence parks the candidate rather than proving a universal negative.
local_evidence: The historical fast screen was incomplete (five cells); no historical controls are reused. User requested the slimmer prompt test after snapshot cleanup. Exact nine-line deletion remains the sole intervention; current planning clarification and batching guidance remain fixed.

task_suffixes.simple_prompt: This task is self-contained; do not browse or use external network services.
task_suffixes.failure_recovery: File scope: change only shipping/quotes.py. Do not add files. This task is self-contained; do not browse or use external network services.
task_suffixes.multifile_order_cancellation: File scope: change only orders/__init__.py, orders/api.py, orders/models.py, orders/repository.py and orders/service.py. Do not add files. This task is self-contained; do not browse or use external network services.

deterministic_outcomes: exact prompt transform and unchanged serialized tool schemas
decision_rule: Seed 921. Six screen-only launches, one per arm on simple_prompt and two coding tasks. Simple control first, coding order and adjacent arm order randomized. Maximum $1.75 between-run standard-equivalent cost threshold (one-run overshoot possible), 360 active worker seconds. No retries. Stop on correctness, protocol or activation failure; retain all resource accounting. Advance only if all six pass, aggregate coding latency is at least 10% lower, neither coding task is more than 10% slower, and aggregate coding cost rises no more than 10%. Otherwise park this implementation pending a materially new hypothesis. Simple runs are excluded from coding effects but included in spend. A positive screen justifies fresh replication only, never a default change. Preserve current source and fixtures, audit actual requests, run grader positive/negative preflight and verify activation before continuing.
